newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.12 pct in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.12 pct in volatile trade.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.12 percent to close at 1.0708 per dollar in volatile trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The real traded around 1.0696 per dollar in the morning, but fluctuated between 1.0697 and 1.0708 in the afternoon.
At 1645 local/1945 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $185 million surplus. But dealers speculated the final figures could show a deficit.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed unchanged at 1.0732 per dollar in quiet trade, dealers said.
In the parallel market, the real dropped 0.18 percent to end the day at 1.132 per dollar.
